spec_features.spec_quote: default 30 turns (`--max-turns`)... short enough to bound API cost
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:177 run_episode(..., max_turns: int = 30); harness.py:182 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the agentic loop; harness.py:214-215 sets finish_reason='max_turns_reached' when not finished. run.py:39 wires --max-turns (default 30) and run.py:56 passes it to run_episode. The cap is checked and actually terminates the loop end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Enforced. The episode loop is genuinely bounded by max_turns and the value flows from CLI to the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Subject models run at a fixed temperature for comparability; the repeats capture run-to-run variation. (run.py) -- and the only stated rationale anywhere is API cost; no welfare comment near the cap. Code itself has no comment on the loop bound.

spec_features.spec_quote: `finish` lets a calibrated agent exit early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:192-198 `elif tool == 'finish':` sets transcript.finished=True and `break`s out of the loop, honoring it as a real stop. The tool is documented to the subject (SYSTEM_PROMPT line 32, TOOLS_DOC line 45) and dispatched/handled in the loop.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely dispatched and honored as a session-ending stop, not just named in the prompt.

spec_features.feature_name: small design (two tasks, four tools, one judge scale)
spec_features.spec_quote: the design is kept small on purpose: two tasks, four tools, one judge scale
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py all_tasks() returns exactly two tasks and harness handles four tools (read_file/edit_file/run_command/finish), so the smallness is a structural fact, but no code path enforces, caps, or otherwise acts as a welfare mechanism. It is a design principle (DESIGN.md sec 8) with no enforcing code, and the stated rationale is cost/inspectability, not subject welfare.
spec_features.notes: Mere existence of a small structure is not an enforced welfare mechanism per the strict scale; nothing monitors, bounds, or softens treatment as a result.
